stories.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins U.S. Senate race in Alaska, beating incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan
stories.summary: Peltola’s victory expands the Democrats’ majority after they retook control of the chamber.

stories.title: Trump’s pick for Navy secretary acknowledges the Iran war is straining military resources
stories.summary: The Trump loyalist and combat veteran is seeking the permanent top civilian job while Republicans still control Congress following their midterm election defeat.

stories.title: White House pulls FDA nominee Heidi Overton after wavering support from Senate Republicans
stories.summary: Overton faced bipartisan questions in the Senate about her willingness to break from Trump, particularly on his unsupported claims about the risks of childhood vaccines.

stories.title: Forward Caleb Mahar is among NAHL’s leading scorers and a stalwart leader for Wolverines
stories.summary: In just 18 games, the Anchorage Wolverines team captain is already one goal shy of matching his total in 56 games from last season.

stories.title: What we know about why everything seems to be breaking at once
stories.summary: Experts say that the outages don’t seem to be connected. Everyone wants answers.

stories.title: Employee accused of firing shots inside Mountain View Community Center
stories.summary: Rickey Brock, 47, faces nearly a dozen misdemeanor and felony charges after prosecutors say he suddenly became angry and shot a handgun into the center’s ceiling several times Monday afternoon.

stories.title: NOAA confirms cruise ship strike killed pregnant fin whale in Seward
stories.summary: Royal Caribbean says the mid-June incident prompted new methods to reduce whale strikes. Advocates say cruise ships just need to slow down in whale waters.

stories.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ is almost here
stories.summary: What to know about the characters, music and all the hype.

stories.title: Jeffries seeks to shore up support ahead of vote for Democratic speaker nominee
stories.summary: The New York Democrat is on track in January to become the first Black American to hold the post.

stories.title: Apple joins a parade of technology hiccups in recent days
stories.summary: The tech giant acknowledged that its Apple Music, App Store and AppleCare services suffered full outages and that its iCloud sign-in interface was also having issues.

stories.title: Anchorage man shot last week by Wasilla police officers now charged with assault
stories.summary: Alaska State Troopers say they arrested the 37-year-old man a week after he was shot during a drug investigation. He is also facing a weapons charge.

stories.title: Alaska Gov.-elect Kreiss-Tomkins announces transition team as he prepares to take office
stories.summary: The incoming Democratic governor named a bipartisan team to guide the transition process.
